copy.anchor: Design the product: turn a validated problem into a version-one design: the shortest path to value, a written cut line and the decisions you will defer. (/playbooks/design-the-product/)
copy.convey: A plan sheet with a cut line: what is in, what waits.
copy.avoid: A blueprint frame (stage-build owns it), screens, a wireframe with readable words.

prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Overhead still life of a paper wireframe sheet with a dashed cut line across it, four six-sided hexagon tiles above the line and a few faded tiles below it. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one tile resting on the dashed line, in amber glass. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
prompts.figure: Editorial documentary photograph of a calm working session around a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, soft north-window daylight, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Framed from the chest down so that no head is in the frame: one person only, in a grey cardigan, seated at a pale table, forearms on the table, moving a hexagon tile toward the dashed line, in front of a paper wireframe sheet with a dashed cut line and hexagon tiles above and below it. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one tile of the model on the dashed line in amber glass. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
